column1: Domestic electricity prices in the EU
Data period: New prices data for Semester 2 2025 (July - December 2025) and historical revisions
Please note this table was initially published at 9:30 on 28/05/2026. On 29/09/2026 the EU14 chart was updated to show the median including tax.
Data in these tables shows prices of electricity for domestic consumers in the UK and EU.
Data is presented by size band, with and without tax and for six-month periods ("semesters") each year (January - June and July - December).
